tests.detail: 5 aspects, zero contract errors
all five required S5 aspects present
every aspect scenario binding resolves in combat_scenarios.json
same seed -> identical capture plan (sha a0ff44fbab19...)
different seed -> different capture plan
camera_start rendered in plan for every binding (same value on both sides by construction)
capture plan spawn comes from the B1-X5 harness plan (same sha, same total)
pair dry-run -> exit 3, NOT_RUN skeleton, template + manifest written, no captures claimed
identical inputs -> identical deterministic core + matching recorded sha
different seed -> different deterministic core
telemetry with s5 extension stays compatible with combat_telemetry_schema.json
missing or nonexistent candidate -> stable USAGE exit 4
no VM launcher -> exit 3, machine-readable manifest with vm_not_launched reasons
--require-event-spine with absent B2-X1 spine -> exit 3 NOT_RUN (documented pre-X1 semantic)
full machine-prepared pair with labeled-synthetic captures + bound build id/modset -> EVIDENCE_PREPARED (0)
no generated manifest/template claims HUMAN_ACCEPTED; machine gate stays EVIDENCE_PREPARED
6 unanswered questions; machine gate EVIDENCE_PREPARED; verdict null
filled checklist (fixture) validates; broken checklist fails with exit 2; driver never writes verdict
validate --package enforces required structure (template present) with exit 0/2
unknown aspect / scenario -> stable nonzero usage exit
driver resolves repo root from nested cwd
no drive-letter / UNC absolute paths in X2-owned files
no secret-like tokens in X2-owned files

proves: the S5 evidence flow parses its aspect catalog, resolves every aspect scenario binding against the B1-X5 harness catalog, reuses the harness spawn plan and telemetry schema, is deterministic (plan + manifest core), produces dry-run/NOT_RUN skeletons with stable exit codes (USAGE 4 / NOT_RUN 3 / EVIDENCE_FAIL 2 / EVIDENCE_PREPARED 0), keeps the machine human gate at EVIDENCE_PREPARED (never HUMAN_ACCEPTED), validates human-filled checklist structure without writing verdicts, and carries no host-absolute paths or secrets
not_proven: in-game execution, real screenshots/frame sequences/video/audio, real B2-X0 aggregate candidate build ids, real B2-X1 event spine telemetry, human S5 acceptance
